exercises.prompt: Połącz nagłówki z treścią.
Which sentence is a good start of a report?
exercises.answer: The aim of this report is to evaluate the sports facilities.
distractors: Hi! Let me tell you about the gym.
I strongly believe that sport is great.
exercises.explanation: Cel raportu: The aim of this report is to...

exercises.prompt: ___ the survey, most students are satisfied.
This report is ___ on a survey of 100 employees. (oparty)
The ___ of the respondents said the canteen was too expensive. (większość)
Ułóż wstęp raportu.
answer: The aim of this report is to evaluate the school library.
It is based on a survey of 80 students.
exercises.explanation: Nagłówek, cel, źródło danych. Powitanie z listu nie pasuje do raportu.

exercises.prompt: I would recommend open the library on Saturdays.

Zamień na stronę bierną, zacznij od „Several problems”.
We identified several problems.
accept: Several problems were identified by us.

exercises.prompt: Większość pracowników jest zadowolona.
exercises.answer: The majority of employees are satisfied.
accept: The majority of the employees are satisfied.
Most of the employees are satisfied.
The majority of employees are happy.

exercises.prompt: Which sentence is suitable for a report?
exercises.answer: A small number of students complained about the noise.
distractors: Some kids moaned about the noise, LOL.
You won't believe how noisy it was!

exercises.prompt: Połącz wyrażenia z tłumaczeniem.
Which sentence uses impersonal style?
exercises.answer: It was found that the equipment is old.
distractors: I found that the equipment is old, sadly.

exercises.prompt: It would be a good idea ___ more bicycle racks.
exercises.explanation: It would be a good idea to...

exercises.prompt: Only 20% ___ the respondents use the gym regularly.
I would ___ extending the opening hours. (polecić)
Ułóż sekcję z rekomendacjami.
answer: I would recommend buying new computers.
It would also be a good idea to extend the opening hours.
exercises.explanation: Nagłówek i dwie rekomendacje. „Write back soon” to zwrot z listu.

exercises.prompt: The majority of the respondent use the library once a week.
exercises.explanation: Liczba mnoga: the majority of the respondents.

The council should install new lights.
accept: New lights should be installed by the council.

exercises.prompt: Ten raport opiera się na ankiecie.
exercises.answer: This report is based on a survey.
accept: This report is based on a questionnaire.

The report is based on a questionnaire.

exercises.prompt: How is a report different from an essay?
exercises.answer: It has headings and makes recommendations.

exercises.prompt: Which is the best heading for a report section?
A ___ of the employees (about 33%) work from home.
The canteen is popular. ___, many students find it too expensive. (jednak)
___ conclusion, the facilities need modernising.
Ułóż zakończenie raportu.
answer: In conclusion, the canteen is popular, but the prices are too high.
If the recommendations are followed, students will be more satisfied.
exercises.explanation: Nagłówek, podsumowanie, efekt rekomendacji. „Lots of love” nie pasuje.

exercises.prompt: According with the survey, the prices are too high.

Zamień na stronę bierną, zacznij od „The survey”.
We carried out the survey in May.
exercises.answer: The survey was carried out in May.
accept: The survey was carried out by us in May.

Sixty per cent of the respondents use the car park.
60% of respondents use the car park.
Sixty percent of respondents use the car park.
Sixty percent of the respondents use the parking lot.
60% of the respondents use the parking lot.

exercises.answer: The management should consider buying new equipment.
